mentions.name: Neon Arcade
mentions.description: A browser-based arcade platform offering a curated collection of free unblocked games and remastered classics, playable instantly in any browser without downloads. Features a mix of nostalgic titles and new casual games spanning genres from puzzle to platformers, with a focus on polish, responsiveness, and a fun vibe.
mentions.problem: People want instant browser-playable games without downloads, including access on school/work networks where games may be blocked.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on Neon Arcade (https://neonarc.app/
